extraction_notes.note: Blueprint formalizes Razborov's flag algebras; core notions and results attributed to Razborov (explicitly or via 'formalizes Razborov's flag algebras') are origin external, while Lean-specific carriers, supporting constructions and the computational layer are origin paper.
Environments are theorem but labelled lem: / named 'Lemma 3.11'; kept as theorem per the environment.
Proofs are one-to-three-sentence sketches of Lean proofs; no rigor field added since the results are machine-checked.

nodes.name: Flag type
nodes.statement: A \emph{flag type} $\sigma$ is a simple graph on a finite label set $T$. It describes the labeled ``root'' every flag of type $\sigma$ must carry.
nodes.label: def:flag-type

nodes.name: Labeled graph
nodes.statement: A \emph{labeled graph} of type $\sigma$ on a vertex type $V$ is a simple graph $G$ on $V$ together with an induced-subgraph embedding $\sigma \hookrightarrow G$. Its image is the set of labeled (``rooted'') vertices.
differentia: together with an induced-subgraph embedding $\sigma \hookrightarrow G$
nodes.label: def:labeled-graph

nodes.name: Labeled subgraph
nodes.statement: A \emph{labeled subgraph} of a labeled graph $G$ is a subgraph of $G$ that still contains all labeled vertices and embeds $\sigma$ compatibly with $G$. These are the pieces cut out when measuring subflag densities.
nodes.label: def:labeled-subgraph

nodes.name: Isomorphism of labeled graphs, $\simeq_f$
nodes.statement: A \emph{labeled-graph isomorphism} $G \simeq_f G'$ is a graph isomorphism of the underlying graphs that commutes with the two type embeddings. Flags are exactly the isomorphism classes for this relation.
nodes.label: def:labeled-graph-iso

nodes.name: Flag
nodes.statement: A \emph{flag} of type $\sigma$ on $V$, $\mathrm{Flag}\,\sigma\,V$, is an isomorphism class of labeled graphs under $\sim_f$ (the equivalence ``$\exists$ a labeled-graph isomorphism''). This is the basic object the flag algebra is built from.
nodes.label: def:flag

nodes.name: Empty flag
nodes.statement: The \emph{empty flag} $\mathrm{emptyFlag}\,\sigma$ is the class of the trivial labeled graph $\sigma$ on $T$ with the identity embedding: the type with no extra vertices. It is the multiplicative unit of the flag algebra.
nodes.label: def:empty-flag

nodes.name: Flag list
nodes.statement: A \emph{flag list} of length $t$ is a tuple $(F_0,\dots,F_{t-1})$ of flags of type $\sigma$, the $i$-th on its own vertex type. Flag lists (with the type-level \texttt{insert}/\texttt{permute} operations) are what let us speak of the simultaneous density of several disjoint flags.
nodes.label: def:flag-list

nodes.name: Empty labeled graph
nodes.statement: The trivial carrier: the type $\sigma$ itself on $T$ with the identity embedding. Its isomorphism class is the empty flag.
nodes.label: def:empty-labeled-graph

nodes.name: Flag equivalence
nodes.statement: The relation $G \sim_f G'$: ``there exists a labeled-graph isomorphism $G \simeq_f G'$''. Flags are its equivalence classes.
nodes.label: def:flag-eqv

nodes.name: Induced labeled subgraph
nodes.statement: The labeled subgraph of $G$ induced on a chosen vertex set $S$ containing all labeled vertices --- the canonical way to cut out a sub-flag on $S$.
nodes.label: def:induced-labeled-subgraph

nodes.name: Labeled-graph list
nodes.statement: A $t$-tuple of labeled graphs, the $i$-th on vertex type $V_i$; the pre-quotient form of a flag list.
nodes.label: def:labeled-graph-list

nodes.name: Type-level list operations
nodes.statement: The operations on a vertex-type family that append a new type at the end ($\mathrm{listTypeInsert}$) or reorder it by a permutation ($\mathrm{listTypePermute}$); they supply the return types of the flag-list operations.
nodes.statement_short: Append or permute vertex types in a family.
nodes.label: def:list-type-ops

nodes.name: Flag-list operations
nodes.statement: Appending a flag to a flag list, and reordering a flag list by a permutation.
nodes.label: def:flag-list-ops

nodes.name: Quotient of lists is a list of flags
nodes.statement: The quotient of labeled-graph lists is equivalent to the tuple of flags: taking isomorphism classes commutes with the $\mathrm{Fin}\,t$-indexed product.
nodes.statement_short: Taking isomorphism classes commutes with finite products of labeled-graph lists.
nodes.label: thm:eqv-quot-list-flaglist

nodes.name: Labeled-graph count
nodes.statement: $\mathrm{labeledGraphCount}\,H\,G$ is the number of induced labeled subgraphs of the host $G$ that are labeled-isomorphic to $H$.
nodes.label: def:labeled-graph-count

nodes.name: Labeled-graph density
nodes.statement: $\mathrm{labeledGraphDensity}\,H\,G$ normalizes the count by the number of ways to choose the non-type vertices of an $H$-sized induced subgraph, i.e.\ by $\binom{|G|-|\sigma|}{|H|-|\sigma|}$, giving a rational in $[0,1]$.
nodes.label: def:labeled-graph-density

nodes.name: Isomorphism invariance
nodes.statement: Labeled-graph density is invariant under $\simeq_f$ in both arguments. This is the well-definedness fact that lets density descend to flags.
conclusions: Labeled-graph density is invariant under $\simeq_f$ in both arguments.
nodes.label: lem:density-iso-invariant

nodes.name: Proof of Isomorphism invariance
nodes.statement: Transport induced copies along the given isomorphisms; the counts, and hence the normalized densities, agree.
nodes.statement_short: Transport induced copies along the isomorphisms so counts and densities agree.

nodes.name: Subflag density
nodes.statement: $\mathrm{subflagDensity} : \mathrm{Flag}\,\sigma\,V \to \mathrm{Flag}\,\sigma\,W \to \mathbb{Q}$ is $\mathrm{labeledGraphDensity}$ lifted through the flag quotient in both arguments: the density of one flag inside another.
nodes.label: def:subflag-density

nodes.name: Boundary values
nodes.statement: The empty flag has density $1$ in every flag; a flag has density $1$ in itself; two distinct flags of the same size have density $0$ in each other.
conclusions: The empty flag has density $1$ in every flag
a flag has density $1$ in itself
two distinct flags of the same size have density $0$ in each other
nodes.label: lem:subflag-density-values

nodes.name: List density and fixed arities
nodes.statement: $\mathrm{flagListDensity}$ counts the induced subgraph-lists of $G$ that simultaneously realize a whole disjoint list of prescribed flags (normalized by the multinomial coefficient distributing the non-type vertices), lifted through the quotient. It generalizes $\mathrm{labeledGraphListDensity}$ on carriers.
nodes.statement_short: Density of a list of disjoint flags simultaneously in a host, lifted to flags.
nodes.label: def:flag-list-density

nodes.name: Single, pair, and triple densities
nodes.statement: The fixed-arity specializations $d_1(F;G)$, $d_2(F_1,F_2;G)$, $d_3(F_1,F_2,F_3;G)$ are list densities of the singleton, pair, and triple lists. $d_2$ is the factor multiplication is built from; $d_1$ is the ordinary subflag density.
nodes.label: def:flag-density-n

nodes.name: Single density is subflag density
nodes.statement: $\mathrm{subflagDensity}\,F\,G = d_1(F;G)$: the single-flag list density coincides with the subflag density of Chapter start, linking the two developments.
nodes.label: thm:subflag-eq-list

nodes.name: Proof of Single density is subflag density
nodes.statement: Both count the same induced copies; unfold the singleton list.
nodes.statement_short: Unfold the singleton list; both count the same induced copies.

nodes.name: Permutation and empty-insertion invariance
nodes.statement: List density is unchanged by permuting the list, and by inserting an empty flag. These symmetries reduce the fixed-arity densities to one another in the chain-rule proofs.
conclusions: List density is unchanged by permuting the list, and by inserting an empty flag.
nodes.label: lem:density-invariance

nodes.name: Density chain rules
nodes.statement: A product-flag density expands as a sum over intermediate flags $G'$ of size $\ell'$ of products of densities, e.g. \[ d_1(F;G) = \sum_{G'} d_1(F;G')\, d_1(G';G), \qquad d_2(F_1,F_2;G) = \sum_{G'} d_1(F_1;G')\, d_2(G',F_2;G). \] The triple rule is foundational; the pair and single rules descend from it. These are the identities the quotient algebra is defined to respect.
nodes.statement_short: Densities expand over intermediate flags as sums of products of densities.
nodes.label: thm:density-chain-rules

nodes.name: Proof of Density chain rules
nodes.statement: Partition the induced copies of the product by the intermediate flag they span on a size-$\ell'$ vertex set, then count each part with the appropriate density.
nodes.statement_short: Double counting: partition induced copies by the intermediate flag they span.

nodes.name: Asymptotic independence of subflag densities
nodes.statement: There is a constant $c = 2(|F|+|F'|)^2$, independent of $G$, with \[ \bigl| d_2(F,F';G) - d_1(F;G)\, d_1(F';G) \bigr| \le \frac{c}{|G|}. \] Distinct subflag densities are thus asymptotically multiplicative --- the probabilistic heart of the ``product of densities'' reasoning.
nodes.statement_short: Pair density is within $O(1/|G|)$ of the product of single densities.
conclusions: There is a constant $c = 2(|F|+|F'|)^2$, independent of $G$, with \[ \bigl| d_2(F,F';G) - d_1(F;G)\, d_1(F';G) \bigr| \le \frac{c}{|G|}. \]
nodes.label: thm:density-prod-approx

nodes.name: Proof of Asymptotic independence
nodes.statement: Model the choice of two vertex subsets as a finite probability space; the discrepancy is the probability that the subsets overlap off the type, which is $O(1/|G|)$ by a union bound.
nodes.statement_short: Probabilistic: discrepancy is an overlap probability, bounded by a union bound.

nodes.name: Size-tagged flag
nodes.statement: A \emph{size-tagged flag} is a dependent pair $\langle n, F\rangle$ of a vertex count $n$ and a flag $F$ on $\mathrm{Fin}\,n$. These are the basis indices of the algebra.
nodes.label: def:fin-flag

nodes.name: Flag vector
nodes.statement: A \emph{flag vector} is a finitely supported real combination of size-tagged flags, i.e.\ an element of $\mathrm{FinFlag}\,\sigma \to_{0} \mathbb{R}$: the underlying module before quotienting.
nodes.genus: finitely supported real combination of size-tagged flags
nodes.label: def:flag-vector

nodes.name: Basis vector
nodes.statement: $\mathrm{basisVector}\,F$ is the unit vector supported on the single flag $F$; every construction reduces to these.
nodes.label: def:basis-vector

nodes.name: Flag multiplication
nodes.statement: The product of two flags is expanded onto flags $G$ of a target size $\ell$, weighted by the pair density: \[ F \cdot F' \;=\; \sum_{G} d_2(F,F';G)\,\cdot G, \] taken at the minimal size $\ell = |F| + |F'| - |\sigma|$ ($\mathrm{flagMul}$); the choice of $\ell$ is irrelevant modulo the averaging relations.
nodes.statement_short: Product of flags is the pair-density-weighted sum over flags of minimal size.
nodes.label: def:flag-mul

nodes.name: Zero space
nodes.statement: The \emph{zero space} $\mathrm{ZeroSpace}\,\sigma$ is the $\mathbb{R}$-submodule spanned by all of Razborov's averaging relations (the set $\mathrm{zeroSet}\,\sigma$). Quotienting by it identifies each flag with its density expansion.
nodes.label: def:zero-space

nodes.name: Flag algebra $\mathcal{A}^\sigma$
nodes.statement: $\mathcal{A}^\sigma = \mathrm{FlagVector}\,\sigma / {\sim_v}$, flag vectors modulo the zero space. It carries a commutative $\mathbb{R}$-algebra structure (built below), with quotient map written $[\![\,\cdot\,]\!]$.
nodes.label: def:flag-algebra

nodes.name: The zero space is an ideal
nodes.statement: Multiplying any flag vector by an averaging relation gives another element of the zero space. Hence multiplication descends to a well-defined operation on the quotient.
conclusions: Multiplying any flag vector by an averaging relation gives another element of the zero space.
nodes.label: thm:zero-space-ideal

nodes.name: Proof of The zero space is an ideal
nodes.statement: Reduce to a basis vector times a generator $\mathrm{zeroElement}\,F\,\ell$ and apply the chain rule (Theorem~\ref{thm:density-chain-rules}), which is exactly the statement that the product of the relation is again a telescoping sum of relations.
nodes.statement_short: Reduce to basis vector times a generator and apply the chain rule.

nodes.name: Associativity modulo $\sim_v$
nodes.statement: $(f\cdot g)\cdot h \sim_v f\cdot(g\cdot h)$. Associativity fails on the nose on flag vectors but holds modulo the zero space, so it lifts to genuine associativity on $\mathcal{A}^\sigma$.
nodes.label: thm:mul-assoc

nodes.name: Proof of Associativity modulo $\sim_v$
nodes.statement: Both sides expand, via the triple-density identity (Theorem~\ref{thm:triple-mul-density}), to the same sum $\sum_{G} d_3(F_1,F_2,F_3;G)\cdot G$.
nodes.statement_short: Expand both sides via the triple-density identity to the same sum.

nodes.name: Product equals density expansion
nodes.statement: In $\mathcal{A}^\sigma$, $[\![F]\!]\cdot[\![G]\!] = [\![\,\mathrm{flagMul}\,F\,G\,]\!]$: the ring product of two flags is the class of their density expansion.
nodes.label: thm:quot-mul-density

nodes.name: Proof of Product equals density expansion
nodes.statement: Unfold the multiplication on the quotient, which is defined by $\mathrm{flagMul}$ and well-defined by Theorem~\ref{thm:zero-space-ideal}.
nodes.statement_short: Unfold quotient multiplication, well-defined by the ideal property.

nodes.name: Same-size flags sum to one
nodes.statement: For every $\ell \ge |\sigma|$, $\sum_{F : |F|=\ell} [\![F]\!] = 1$ in $\mathcal{A}^\sigma$: the sum over all flags of a fixed size is the unit. This normalization is used pervasively in density proofs.
nodes.label: thm:sum-flags-eq-one

nodes.name: Proof of Same-size flags sum to one
nodes.statement: Specialize the density-expansion identity (Theorem~\ref{thm:basis-quot-eq-sum}) to the empty flag, whose density in every size-$\ell$ flag is $1$.
nodes.statement_short: Specialize the density-expansion identity to the empty flag.

nodes.name: Flag of fixed size
nodes.statement: $\mathrm{FlagWithSize}\,\sigma\,n = \mathrm{Flag}\,\sigma\,(\mathrm{Fin}\,n)$: a flag on the fixed $n$-element carrier.
nodes.label: def:flag-with-size

nodes.name: Density expansion
nodes.statement: $\mathrm{flagExpansion}\,F\,\ell = \sum_{F'} d_1(F;F')\,\cdot F'$, the averaged expansion of $F$ onto size-$\ell$ flags.
nodes.label: def:flag-expansion

nodes.name: Averaging relation
nodes.statement: Razborov's generating relation $\mathrm{zeroElement}\,F\,\ell = F - \mathrm{flagExpansion}\,F\,\ell$, identified with $0$ in the algebra.
nodes.label: def:zero-element

nodes.name: Relation set
nodes.statement: The set of all averaging relations $\mathrm{zeroElement}\,F\,\ell$ (with $|F| \le \ell$); its span is the zero space.
nodes.label: def:zero-set

nodes.name: Flag equivalence of vectors
nodes.statement: $f \sim_v g$ iff $f - g \in \mathrm{ZeroSpace}\,\sigma$: the two vectors represent the same flag-algebra element.
nodes.label: def:flag-vector-eqv

nodes.name: Quotient map is a homomorphism
nodes.statement: The quotient map $[\![\,\cdot\,]\!]$ commutes with addition, multiplication, scalar multiplication, and finite sums.
nodes.label: thm:quot-hom

nodes.name: Triple product expansion
nodes.statement: The product of three flags is, modulo $\sim_v$, the size-$\ell$ sum weighted by the triple density $d_3$. This is the engine behind associativity (Theorem~\ref{thm:mul-assoc}).
nodes.label: thm:triple-mul-density

nodes.name: Flag class as density expansion
nodes.statement: In the algebra, $[\![F]\!] = \sum_{F'} d_1(F;F')\,[\![F']\!]$ over size-$\ell$ flags: the averaging relation written as a $[\![\,\cdot\,]\!]$ identity.
nodes.label: thm:basis-quot-eq-sum

nodes.name: Nontriviality
nodes.statement: $0 \ne 1$ in $\mathcal{A}^\sigma$: the flag algebra is nontrivial (so its $\mathrm{CommRing}$ structure is not the zero ring).
nodes.label: thm:flag-algebra-nontrivial

nodes.name: Proof of Nontriviality
nodes.statement: If $1$ lay in $\mathrm{ZeroSpace}\,\sigma$ it would be a finite combination of averaging relations. But the linear functional $\varphi(G') = d_1(G';F)$ (density into a fixed large flag $F$) sends every generator $\mathrm{zeroElement}\,G\,\ell$ to $0$ by the chain rule (Theorem~\ref{thm:density-chain-rules}), while $\varphi(1) = 1$ --- a contradiction.
nodes.statement_short: Contradiction: the density functional into a large flag kills all relations but sends 1 to 1.

nodes.name: Unlabel
nodes.statement: $\mathrm{unlabel}$ drops the type embedding of a single flag, returning its underlying graph as an unlabeled ($\emptyset$-type) flag.
nodes.label: def:unlabel

nodes.name: Downward normalizing factor
nodes.statement: The strictly positive rational weight of a flag: the fraction of label placements (injections of the $|\sigma|$ labels into the vertices) that realize it. It is the coefficient by which $\mathrm{unlabel}\,F$ is scaled.
nodes.label: def:downward-factor

nodes.name: The bridge set, counted three ways
nodes.statement: The set of pairs (vertex subset, injective label assignment) embedding a labeled flag into an unlabeled one is counted three ways: by isomorphism-count times labeled count; by summing labeled counts over labellings of the same graph; and, grouped by label-extension flag, over all relabellings.
nodes.statement_short: The bridge set of (vertex subset, label injection) pairs is counted in three ways.
nodes.label: lem:bridge-counts

nodes.name: Counting identity
nodes.statement: Equating the three counts yields \[ d_1(\mathrm{unlabel}\,F;\,F')\cdot w(F) \;=\; \sum_{G \in \mathrm{ext}(F')} d_1(F;G)\cdot w(G), \] where $w$ is the normalizing factor and $\mathrm{ext}(F')$ ranges over the relabellings of $F'$. This is the algebraic engine of well-definedness.
nodes.statement_short: Unlabeled density times weight equals weighted sum of labeled densities over relabellings.
nodes.label: thm:counting-identity

nodes.name: Proof of Counting identity
nodes.statement: Combine the first and third counts of Lemma~\ref{lem:bridge-counts} and divide by the number of label injections.
nodes.statement_short: Combine two of the three bridge-set counts and divide by the number of label injections.

nodes.name: Downward respects the zero space
nodes.statement: The unlabeling map sends the zero space of $\sigma$ into the zero space of the empty type, so it descends to the quotient algebra.
conclusions: The unlabeling map sends the zero space of $\sigma$ into the zero space of the empty type
nodes.label: lem:downward-well-defined

nodes.name: Proof of Downward respects the zero space
nodes.statement: The zero space is spanned by the generating relations, each of which downward sends into the zero space of the empty type (Lemma~\ref{lem:downward-zero-element}).
nodes.statement_short: Check on generators: downward sends each averaging relation into the empty-type zero space.

nodes.name: Downward operator
nodes.statement: $[\![\,\cdot\,]\!]_0 : \mathcal{A}^\sigma \to \mathcal{A}^\emptyset$ is the $\mathbb{R}$-linear map induced by $F \mapsto w(F)\cdot \mathrm{unlabel}\,F$; it averages a labeled element over all unlabelings.
nodes.label: def:downward

nodes.name: Identity on the empty type
nodes.statement: On $\mathcal{A}^\emptyset$ there is nothing to unlabel, so $[\![f]\!]_0 = f$.
nodes.label: thm:downward-empty

nodes.name: Empty type
nodes.statement: The empty flag type $\varnothing_t$ (written $\emptyset$) with no labeled vertices; its flags are unlabeled graphs, and density bounds live in $\mathcal{A}^\emptyset$.
nodes.label: def:empty-type

nodes.name: Isomorphism count
nodes.statement: The number of label placements on the same underlying graph as $G$ that are flag-isomorphic to $G$.
nodes.label: def:isomorphism-count

nodes.name: Unlabeled graph
nodes.statement: Forgetting the type embedding of a labeled graph, as a graph ($\mathrm{unlabeledGraph}$) and as its flag class ($\mathrm{unlabeledGraphQuot}$).
nodes.label: def:unlabeled-graph

nodes.name: Label extensions
nodes.statement: For an unlabeled flag $F$, the finset of all $\sigma$-labeled flags of the same size whose unlabeling is $F$ --- the ways to re-add a labelling.
nodes.label: def:label-extensions

nodes.name: Downward image of a flag
nodes.statement: $\mathrm{downwardFlag}\,F = w(F)\cdot\mathrm{unlabel}\,F$ on a single flag, its linear extension $\mathrm{downwardFlagVector}$ to flag vectors, and the quotient-level $\mathrm{downwardFlagVectorQuot}$ --- the raw form of downward before descending to the quotient.
nodes.label: def:downward-flag

nodes.name: Downward averaging expansion
nodes.statement: $\mathrm{downwardFlag}\,F \sim_v \sum_{G} d_1(F;G)\cdot\mathrm{downwardFlag}\,G$ over size-$\ell$ flags --- the averaging expansion driving well-definedness.
nodes.label: lem:downward-flag-sum

nodes.name: Downward of a relation is a relation
nodes.statement: $\mathrm{downwardFlagVector}$ sends each generating relation $\mathrm{zeroElement}\,F\,\ell$ into the zero space of the empty type.
nodes.label: lem:downward-zero-element

nodes.name: The normalizing factor is positive
nodes.statement: $w(F) > 0$ for every flag $F$: every flag is realized by at least one label placement.
nodes.label: lem:downward-factor-pos

nodes.name: Positive homomorphism
nodes.statement: A \emph{positive homomorphism} is an $\mathbb{R}$-algebra homomorphism $\varphi : \mathcal{A}^\sigma \to \mathbb{R}$ that is nonnegative on every flag. These are the semantic evaluations of the algebra --- the limits of subgraph densities.
nodes.label: def:positive-hom

nodes.name: Semantic cone
nodes.statement: The \emph{semantic cone} is $\{\, f \mid \varphi(f) \ge 0 \text{ for all positive } \varphi \,\}$. Membership is exactly an unconditional density inequality.
nodes.label: def:semantic-cone

nodes.name: Semantic order
nodes.statement: Define $f \le g$ to mean $g - f$ lies in the semantic cone, i.e.\ every positive homomorphism satisfies $\varphi(f) \le \varphi(g)$. This is a preorder on $\mathcal{A}^\sigma$, the order in which all bounds are stated.
nodes.label: def:semantic-order

nodes.name: Flags are nonnegative
nodes.statement: Every flag satisfies $[\![F]\!] \ge 0$ --- the base positivity fact from which sum-of-squares bounds are assembled.
nodes.label: thm:flag-nonneg

nodes.name: Order arithmetic
nodes.statement: The semantic order is compatible with the algebra operations: inequalities may be added termwise, and a nonnegative scalar times a nonnegative element is nonnegative.
nodes.label: lem:order-monotone

nodes.name: Flag quadratic form
nodes.statement: Given a matrix $M$ and a vector $v = (v_1,\dots,v_n)$ of flag-algebra elements, \[ \mathrm{flagQuadraticForm}\,M\,v \;=\; \sum_{i,j} M_{ij}\,(v_i\, v_j), \] the raw sum-of-squares certificate object.
nodes.label: def:flag-quadratic-form

nodes.name: PSD forms are nonnegative
nodes.statement: If $M \succeq 0$ (positive semidefinite) then $\mathrm{flagQuadraticForm}\,M\,v \ge 0$ in the semantic cone.
nodes.label: thm:sos-nonneg

nodes.name: Proof of PSD forms are nonnegative
nodes.statement: Apply any positive homomorphism $\varphi$: it turns the form into $\sum_{ij} M_{ij}\,\varphi(v_i)\varphi(v_j) = x^\top M x \ge 0$ with $x_i = \varphi(v_i)$, since $M \succeq 0$.
nodes.statement_short: Apply a positive homomorphism; the form becomes $x^\top M x \ge 0$.

nodes.name: Unlabeled PSD forms are nonnegative
nodes.statement: The unlabeled form $[\![\,\mathrm{flagQuadraticForm}\,M\,v\,]\!]_0 \ge 0$ for $M \succeq 0$. This is the certificate actually used, since density bounds live in the unlabeled algebra $\mathcal{A}^\emptyset$.
nodes.label: thm:sos-downward-nonneg

nodes.name: Proof of Unlabeled PSD forms are nonnegative
nodes.statement: The form is in the semantic cone by Theorem~\ref{thm:sos-nonneg}, and downward preserves the semantic cone (Theorem~\ref{thm:downward-preserve-cone}), so its unlabeling is nonnegative.
nodes.statement_short: Combine PSD nonnegativity with cone preservation under downward.

nodes.name: Algebra homomorphism type
nodes.statement: $\mathrm{Hom}\,\sigma = \mathcal{A}^\sigma \to_{\mathbb{R}\text{-alg}} \mathbb{R}$, the underlying $\mathbb{R}$-algebra homomorphisms; a positive homomorphism is such a map that is additionally nonnegative on flags.
nodes.label: def:hom

nodes.name: Vector of algebra elements
nodes.statement: $\mathrm{FlagAlgebraVec}\,\sigma\,n = \mathrm{Fin}\,n \to \mathcal{A}^\sigma$, the variables of a quadratic form.
nodes.label: def:flag-algebra-vec

nodes.name: Homomorphisms are nonnegative on flags
nodes.statement: $0 \le \varphi[\![F]\!]$ for every positive homomorphism $\varphi$ and flag $F$ --- the defining positivity, restated as $0 \le \cdot$.
assumptions: for every positive homomorphism $\varphi$ and flag $F$
nodes.label: lem:positivehom-basisvector-nonneg

nodes.name: Order via nonnegative difference
nodes.statement: $f \le g \iff 0 \le g - f$.
nodes.label: lem:flag-sub-nonneg

nodes.name: Translation invariance of the order
nodes.statement: Adding a fixed element on either side preserves the semantic order; these register as the \texttt{AddLeftMono}/\texttt{AddRightMono} instances.
nodes.label: lem:order-monotone-sides

nodes.name: Flag sequence
nodes.statement: A \emph{flag sequence} is a sequence $\mathbb{N} \to \mathrm{FinFlag}\,\sigma$ of flags, typically of growing size.
nodes.label: def:flag-seq

nodes.name: Density space
nodes.statement: The compact, metrizable space of density profiles $\mathrm{FinFlag}\,\sigma \to [0,1]$ (a Tychonoff cube); the ambient space of the limit semantics.
nodes.label: def:flag-density-space

nodes.name: Convergence
nodes.statement: $\mathrm{ConvergesTo}\,s\,a$ says the flag sequence $s$ has strictly increasing sizes and its subgraph-density profile converges pointwise to the limit $a$.
nodes.label: def:converges-to

nodes.name: Density profile of a homomorphism
nodes.statement: Each positive homomorphism $\varphi$ has a density profile $F \mapsto \varphi[\![F]\!]$; this is the injective bridge from the algebraic to the analytic side.
nodes.label: def:positive-hom-coe

nodes.name: Positive homomorphism space
nodes.statement: The range of the profile map; shown to be closed, hence compact and measurable.
nodes.label: def:positive-hom-space

nodes.name: Algebraic characterization
nodes.statement: A density profile arises from a positive homomorphism iff it satisfies the chain rule (\texttt{zeroSpaceProp}), normalization $a(1)=1$ (\texttt{oneProp}), and multiplicativity through pair densities (\texttt{mulProp}).
nodes.statement_short: Profiles of positive homomorphisms are exactly those satisfying chain rule, normalization and multiplicativity.
nodes.label: thm:positive-hom-space-char

nodes.name: Every limit is a homomorphism (Razborov Theorem 3.3a)
nodes.statement: Any convergent flag-sequence density limit is the profile of some positive homomorphism.
conclusions: is the profile of some positive homomorphism
nodes.label: thm:limit-is-hom

nodes.name: Proof of Every limit is a homomorphism (Razborov 3.3a)
nodes.statement: The limit inherits the three structural properties of Theorem~\ref{thm:positive-hom-space-char} from the finite densities, so it lies in the positive-homomorphism space.
nodes.statement_short: The limit inherits the three characterizing properties, so lies in the hom space.

nodes.name: Every homomorphism is a limit (Razborov Theorem 3.3b)
nodes.statement: Conversely every positive homomorphism arises as a convergent flag-sequence limit.
conclusions: arises as a convergent flag-sequence limit
nodes.label: thm:hom-is-limit

nodes.name: Proof of Every homomorphism is a limit (Razborov 3.3b)
nodes.statement: Sample random flags from the profile and apply a Chebyshev / Borel--Cantelli second-moment argument to get almost-sure convergence to $\varphi$.
nodes.statement_short: Probabilistic: sample random flags and use a Chebyshev / Borel-Cantelli second-moment argument.

nodes.name: Random flag distribution
nodes.statement: Turns a large unlabeled flag of positive $\sigma$-density into a distribution on density profiles: draw a random labelling extension weighted by its normalizing factor and read off its density vector.
nodes.label: def:finflag-pmf

nodes.name: Random homomorphism measure (Razborov Theorem 3.5)
nodes.statement: For a base homomorphism $\varphi_0$ on the empty type with $\varphi_0\langle\sigma\rangle_0 > 0$, there is a probability measure $\mathbb{P}[\varphi_0]$ on the positive-homomorphism space whose expectation recovers the normalized downward operator: \[ \int \varphi(f)\, d\mathbb{P}[\varphi_0] \;=\; \frac{\varphi_0[\![f]\!]_0}{\varphi_0[\![1]\!]_0}. \]
nodes.statement_short: A probability measure on positive homomorphisms whose expectation is the normalized downward operator.
assumptions: a base homomorphism $\varphi_0$ on the empty type with $\varphi_0\langle\sigma\rangle_0 > 0$
conclusions: there is a probability measure $\mathbb{P}[\varphi_0]$ on the positive-homomorphism space whose expectation recovers the normalized downward operator
nodes.label: thm:random-hom-measure

nodes.name: Proof of Random homomorphism measure (Razborov 3.5)
nodes.statement: Build $\mathbb{P}[\varphi_0]$ as a Prokhorov weak limit of the finite distributions of Definition~\ref{def:finflag-pmf} along a converging flag sequence; its support lies in the positive-homomorphism space, and the integral is computed on the dense finite level.
nodes.statement_short: Construct the measure as a Prokhorov weak limit of finite random-flag distributions.

nodes.name: Downward preserves the semantic cone
nodes.statement: If $f$ is semantically nonnegative in the typed algebra then so is its unlabeling in the empty-type algebra: \[ f \in \mathrm{semanticCone}\,\sigma \;\Longrightarrow\; [\![f]\!]_0 \in \mathrm{semanticCone}\,\emptyset. \] This is the bridge that turns typed nonnegativity into unlabeled nonnegativity, and it is what the sum-of-squares certificates (Theorem~\ref{thm:sos-downward-nonneg}) and the square/Cauchy--Schwarz results below rest on.
nodes.statement_short: Downward maps the typed semantic cone into the unlabeled semantic cone.
assumptions: $f$ is semantically nonnegative in the typed algebra
conclusions: so is its unlabeling in the empty-type algebra
nodes.label: thm:downward-preserve-cone

nodes.name: Proof of Downward preserves the semantic cone
nodes.statement: Fix a base homomorphism $\varphi_0$. If $\varphi_0\langle\sigma\rangle_0 = 0$ then $\varphi_0[\![f]\!]_0 = 0$ (Lemma~\ref{lem:downward-zero-at-hom}). Otherwise it is positive, and Theorem~\ref{thm:prob-measure-spec} expresses $\varphi_0[\![f]\!]_0$ as the positive multiple $\varphi_0[\![1]\!]_0 \cdot \int \varphi(f)\, d\mathbb{P}[\varphi_0]$ (Lemma~\ref{lem:positivehom-one-downward-pos}) of the integral of a nonnegative integrand, hence $\ge 0$.
nodes.statement_short: Case analysis on $\varphi_0\langle\sigma\rangle_0$: degenerate case is zero, else write as positive multiple of an integral of a nonnegative integrand.

nodes.name: Squares have nonnegative average
nodes.statement: $[\![f\cdot f]\!]_0 \ge 0$ for every $f$: the downward image of a square is nonnegative.
nodes.label: thm:square-downward-nonneg

nodes.name: Proof of Squares have nonnegative average
nodes.statement: Every homomorphism sends $f\cdot f$ to $\varphi(f)^2 \ge 0$, so $f\cdot f$ is in the semantic cone; apply Theorem~\ref{thm:downward-preserve-cone}.
nodes.statement_short: Squares are in the semantic cone; apply cone preservation under downward.

nodes.name: Cauchy-Schwarz inequality for the downward operator
nodes.statement: $[\![f\cdot f]\!]_0 \cdot [\![g\cdot g]\!]_0 \ge [\![f\cdot g]\!]_0^2$, the key inequality behind semidefinite flag-algebra density bounds.
nodes.statement_short: Cauchy-Schwarz inequality for unlabeled averages of products.
nodes.label: thm:cauchy-schwarz

nodes.name: Proof of Cauchy--Schwarz for downward
nodes.statement: Apply the $L^2$ Cauchy--Schwarz (Hölder) inequality to the evaluation functions $\varphi \mapsto \varphi(f), \varphi(g)$ under $\mathbb{P}[\varphi_0]$ (Theorem~\ref{thm:prob-measure-spec}), handling the degenerate base case with Lemma~\ref{lem:downward-zero-at-hom}.
nodes.statement_short: Apply $L^2$ Cauchy-Schwarz under the random homomorphism measure; handle the degenerate case separately.

nodes.name: Increasing sizes
nodes.statement: A flag sequence has strictly increasing flag sizes.
nodes.label: def:increases

nodes.name: Density profile of a sequence
nodes.statement: $n \mapsto (F \mapsto d_1(F; s_n))$, the profile whose limit defines the semantics.
nodes.label: def:flag-density-seq

nodes.name: Homomorphism as a PMF
nodes.statement: The distribution on size-$\ell$ flags whose mass at $F$ is $\varphi[\![F]\!]$; $\varphi$'s random model at scale $\ell$.
nodes.label: def:positivehom-topmf

nodes.name: Flag-sequence measure
nodes.statement: The independent product measure $\mu\{\varphi\}$ on sequences of flags, each component drawn from $\varphi$'s PMF; the source of the random flag sequence in Theorem~\ref{thm:hom-is-limit}.
nodes.label: def:flagseq-measure

nodes.name: Expected density is the downward ratio
nodes.statement: The expected $F$-density under a large flag's measure equals the normalized downward density ratio; the finite-level identity behind Lemma~3.11.
nodes.label: lem:integral-density-div

nodes.name: Razborov Lemma 3.11: convergence of expected densities
nodes.statement: Along a flag sequence converging to $\varphi$, the expected $F$-densities tend to the normalized downward value $\varphi[\![\,[\![F]\!]\,]\!]_0 / \varphi[\![1]\!]_0$.
assumptions: Along a flag sequence converging to $\varphi$
conclusions: the expected $F$-densities tend to the normalized downward value $\varphi[\![\,[\![F]\!]\,]\!]_0 / \varphi[\![1]\!]_0$
nodes.label: thm:lemma-3-11

nodes.name: Limit measure is supported on homomorphisms
nodes.statement: The weak limit of a convergent flag sequence's probability measures is concentrated on the positive-homomorphism space.
conclusions: The weak limit of a convergent flag sequence's probability measures is concentrated on the positive-homomorphism space.
nodes.label: lem:measure-support

nodes.name: The measure $\mathbb{P}[\varphi_0]$
nodes.statement: The chosen random-extension measure $\mathbb{P}[\varphi_0]$, the witness of Theorem~\ref{thm:random-hom-measure}.
nodes.label: def:prob-measure-witness

nodes.name: Defining property of $\mathbb{P}[\varphi_0]$
nodes.statement: Integrating $\varphi \mapsto \varphi(f)$ against $\mathbb{P}[\varphi_0]$ recovers $\varphi_0[\![f]\!]_0 / \varphi_0[\![1]\!]_0$.
nodes.label: thm:prob-measure-spec

nodes.name: Degenerate base homomorphism
nodes.statement: If $\varphi_0\langle\sigma\rangle_0 = 0$ then $\varphi_0[\![f]\!]_0 = 0$ for all $f$ --- the degenerate case handled separately in the cone and Cauchy--Schwarz arguments.
nodes.label: lem:downward-zero-at-hom

nodes.name: Positive denominator
nodes.statement: If $\varphi_0\langle\sigma\rangle_0 > 0$ then $\varphi_0[\![1]\!]_0 > 0$, the denominator in the normalized downward value.
nodes.label: lem:positivehom-one-downward-pos

nodes.name: Edge-set graph
nodes.statement: A computable simple graph on $\mathrm{Fin}\,n$: a finite set of non-loop edges in $\mathrm{Sym}_2(\mathrm{Fin}\,n)$. It decodes to an abstract (empty-type) labeled graph.
nodes.label: def:sym2-graph

nodes.name: Edge-set labeled graph
nodes.statement: The typed version: an edge set together with a graph embedding of a decoded type $\sigma$; decodes to an abstract $\mathrm{LabeledGraph}$.
nodes.label: def:sym2-labeled-graph

nodes.name: Computable flag
nodes.statement: The computable counterpart of $\mathrm{Flag}\,\sigma$: edge-set labeled graphs modulo a computable flag equivalence, carrying effective $\mathrm{Fintype}$/$\mathrm{DecidableEq}$ instances.
nodes.label: def:sym2-flag

nodes.name: Cheap iso invariant
nodes.statement: A cheap $O(n)$ isomorphism invariant --- edge count paired with the sorted degree sequence --- used to prefilter before the expensive isomorphism test.
nodes.label: def:deg-key

nodes.name: The key is an invariant
nodes.statement: Equivalent graphs share the cheap key, justifying its use as a deduplication prefilter.
conclusions: Equivalent graphs share the cheap key
nodes.label: thm:deg-key-iso-invariant

nodes.name: Fast isomorphism test
nodes.statement: Permutation-search isomorphism decision procedures for edge-set graphs (empty and $\sigma$-typed), early-exiting on unequal keys; each is proved sound and complete against flag equivalence.
nodes.label: def:fast-iso

nodes.name: Fast decidability instance
nodes.statement: The high-priority $\mathrm{Decidable}$ instance for flag equivalence backed by the fast test; it makes $\mathrm{Fintype}$-based flag enumeration tractable.
nodes.label: def:fast-iso-decidable

nodes.name: Computable normalizing factor, certified
nodes.statement: A computable downward normalizing factor on edge-set flags, proved equal to the abstract $\mathrm{downwardNormalizingFactor}$ on the decoded flag.
nodes.label: thm:downward-compute

nodes.name: Computable densities, certified
nodes.statement: Computable single- and pair-densities on edge-set flags, each proved equal to the abstract $d_1$, $d_2$ --- so a density computed in the edge-set representation is provably the abstract value.
nodes.label: thm:density-compute

nodes.name: Flag enumeration, complete
nodes.statement: Orderly (McKay-style) augmentation with cheap-key dedup generates one representative per isomorphism class; the generated set is proved to exhaust $\mathrm{Finset.univ}$, so enumeration is complete.
nodes.label: thm:flag-enumeration

nodes.name: Computable empty-typed flag
nodes.statement: The computable counterpart of $\mathrm{Flag}\,\emptyset\,(\mathrm{Fin}\,n)$: edge-set graphs modulo computable flag equivalence.
nodes.label: def:sym2-empty-flag

nodes.name: Placement counts
nodes.statement: The computable numerators of the densities: the number of vertex-disjoint placements of a flag list inside a host, empty-typed and $\sigma$-typed.
nodes.label: def:sym2-count

nodes.name: Computable single density
nodes.statement: The computable single subflag density on empty-typed edge-set flags.
nodes.label: def:sym2-density1

nodes.name: Computable pair density
nodes.statement: The computable pair (multiplication) density on $\sigma$-typed edge-set flags.
nodes.label: def:sym2-density2

nodes.name: Degree sequence
nodes.statement: The sorted degree sequence of an edge-set graph, the main part of the cheap isomorphism key.
nodes.label: def:deg-seq

nodes.name: Permutation builder
nodes.statement: Assembles a full vertex permutation that fixes the type embedding and routes the remaining vertices through a chosen permutation --- the inner loop of the fast isomorphism search.
nodes.label: def:build-full-map

nodes.name: Edge and triangle densities
nodes.statement: $K_2, K_3 \in \mathcal{A}^\emptyset$ are the edge- and triangle-density basis elements. For a positive homomorphism $\varphi$, $\varphi(K_2)$ is the edge density and $\varphi(K_3)$ the triangle density.
nodes.label: def:densities

nodes.name: Expansion of the edge density
nodes.statement: Expanding onto three vertices, $K_2 = \tfrac13 E_3 + \tfrac23 P_3 + K_3$, where $E_3, P_3, K_3$ are the one-edge, path, and triangle densities.
nodes.label: lem:expand-k2

nodes.name: Square-positivity certificate
nodes.statement: Unlabelling the square of the difference of the two rooted two-vertex flags, \[ [\![\,(O_2^{1} - K_2^{1})^2\,]\!]_0 = O_3 - \tfrac13 E_3 - \tfrac13 P_3 + K_3 \;\ge\; 0, \] a sum-of-squares certificate: the left side is a downward-of-square, hence nonnegative by Theorem~\ref{thm:square-downward-nonneg}.
nodes.statement_short: Explicit SOS certificate from unlabelling a square of rooted two-vertex flags.
nodes.label: lem:square-cert

nodes.name: Mantel's theorem, flag-algebra form
nodes.statement: In $\mathcal{A}^\emptyset$, $K_2 \le \tfrac12\cdot 1 + K_3$.
nodes.label: thm:mantel-flag

nodes.name: Proof of Mantel, flag-algebra form
nodes.statement: Substitute the expansion of Lemma~\ref{lem:expand-k2}, add the certificate of Lemma~\ref{lem:square-cert} and the nonnegativity of the three-vertex densities, and collect terms using the order arithmetic of Lemma~\ref{lem:order-monotone}.
nodes.statement_short: Substitute the $K_2$ expansion, add the SOS certificate and nonnegativity, collect terms.

nodes.name: Mantel's theorem, homomorphism form
nodes.statement: For every positive homomorphism $\varphi$ with $\varphi(K_3) = 0$ (a triangle-free limit), $\varphi(K_2) \le \tfrac12$.
assumptions: every positive homomorphism $\varphi$ with $\varphi(K_3) = 0$ (a triangle-free limit)
nodes.label: thm:mantel-hom

nodes.name: Proof of Mantel, homomorphism form
nodes.statement: Apply $\varphi$ to Theorem~\ref{thm:mantel-flag}; positivity and $\varphi(K_3)=0$ give $\varphi(K_2) \le \tfrac12$.
nodes.statement_short: Apply $\varphi$ to the flag-algebra form and use $\varphi(K_3)=0$.

nodes.name: Complete-bipartite lower bound
nodes.statement: For $n \ge 2$, the maximal edge density of a triangle-free graph on $n$ vertices is at least $\tfrac12$, witnessed by the balanced complete bipartite graph: $\operatorname{ex}(n,K_3)/\binom{n}{2} \ge \tfrac12$.
conclusions: the maximal edge density of a triangle-free graph on $n$ vertices is at least $\tfrac12$
nodes.label: lem:lower-bound

nodes.name: Mantel's theorem (Turán density of the triangle)
nodes.statement: $\pi(K_3) = \tfrac12$.
nodes.label: thm:turan-k3

nodes.name: Proof of Tur\'an density of the triangle
nodes.statement: The homomorphism form gives the upper bound $\pi(K_3) \le \tfrac12$; the complete-bipartite construction gives the matching lower bound. They meet at $\tfrac12$.
nodes.statement_short: Combine the homomorphism-form upper bound with the complete-bipartite lower bound.

nodes.name: Degenerate base case
nodes.statement: Fix a base homomorphism $\varphi_0$. If $\varphi_0\langle\sigma\rangle_0 = 0$ then $\varphi_0[\![f]\!]_0 = 0$ (Lemma~\ref{lem:downward-zero-at-hom}).
nodes.statement_short: Fix $\varphi_0$; degenerate case gives zero by the degenerate-base lemma.

nodes.name: Nondegenerate case
nodes.statement: Otherwise it is positive, and Theorem~\ref{thm:prob-measure-spec} expresses $\varphi_0[\![f]\!]_0$ as the positive multiple $\varphi_0[\![1]\!]_0 \cdot \int \varphi(f)\, d\mathbb{P}[\varphi_0]$ (Lemma~\ref{lem:positivehom-one-downward-pos}) of the integral of a nonnegative integrand, hence $\ge 0$.
nodes.statement_short: Nondegenerate case: positive multiple of an integral of a nonnegative integrand.
